about: Two planted defects in the verification plan, applied only to the benchmark copy of the source: every failed check read as failed exactly as before, and a failure as before counted as the pass completion needs.

mutations.find: { state: "failed-as-before", when: (r) => r.word === AS_BEFORE, settled: true },
export const verifiedSome = (lw) => planOf(lw).required.some((c) => VERIFYING.includes(c.purpose) && c.state === "passed");
mutations.replace: export const verifiedSome = (lw) => planOf(lw).required.some((c) => VERIFYING.includes(c.purpose) && c.settled);
